questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Azure Monitor: the Azure portal tool used to query Azure Monitor log data.
Azure Monitor: a platform for collecting, analyzing, and acting on telemetry from Azure, on-premises, and multicloud resources and applications.
